<script>
(function(){
  const modal = document.getElementById('modal');
  const telegramChoice = document.getElementById('telegramChoice');
  const maxChoice = document.getElementById('maxChoice');
  const telegramBase = 'https://t.me/you_website';
  const maxUrl = 'https://max.ru/u/f9LHodD0cOLPI6sgdO_y7eYv6jzceeRZGEELsdhqIzJ4u2YlzDuFWQ4WLzA';
  const defaultMessage = 'Здравствуйте! Хочу обсудить создание сайта.';

  // Cookie notice intentionally reappears on every fresh page visit; OK hides it for this visit.
  const cookieToast = document.getElementById('cookieToast');
  const cookieOk = document.getElementById('cookieOk');
  if (cookieOk && cookieToast) {
    cookieOk.addEventListener('click', function(){ cookieToast.remove(); });
  }


  // Keep the direct messenger destinations available even if JavaScript is blocked.
  telegramChoice.href = telegramBase;
  maxChoice.href = maxUrl;

  function openContactChooser(message) {
    const contactMessage = message || defaultMessage;
    telegramChoice.href = telegramBase + '?text=' + encodeURIComponent(contactMessage);
    maxChoice.href = maxUrl;
    modal.classList.add('open');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }
  function closeModal() {
    modal.classList.remove('open');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-contact]').forEach(function(el) {
    el.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      openContactChooser(el.getAttribute('data-contact') || defaultMessage);
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-plan]').forEach(function(el) {
    el.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      openContactChooser('Здравствуйте! Хочу обсудить: ' + el.getAttribute('data-plan') + '.');
    });
  });
  document.getElementById('closeModal').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  modal.addEventListener('click', function(event) { if (event.target === modal) closeModal(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event) { if (event.key === 'Escape') closeModal(); });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
